title: GraphLoom: Reliability-Calibrated Graph Evidence Routing for Multimodal KG-RAG
abstract: arXiv:2608.15056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems often rely on long unstructured contexts or aggressively expanded evidence graphs, which can introduce noisy evidence, weaken multi-hop reasoning, and increase unsupported generation. We present GraphLoom, a reliability-calibrated multimodal knowledge-graph RAG framework for compact and faithful evidence routing. Given a question and its associated multimodal input, GraphLoom constructs an instance-level multimodal knowledge graph from grounded scene descriptions, extracted relational triples, and external commonsense knowledge. Instead of injecting all retrieved evidence into the generator, GraphLoom performs reliability-aware subgraph retrieval with bounded expansion and selectively routes high-utility evidence through hierarchical graph memory slots and joint graph-sequence attention in a frozen language model. translated_title: GraphLoom：面向多模态知识图谱RAG的可靠性校准图证据路由
translated_abstract: 多模态检索增强生成（RAG）系统通常依赖冗长的非结构化上下文或激进扩展的证据图，这可能引入噪声证据、削弱多跳推理能力，并增加无依据生成的风险。我们提出GraphLoom，一种可靠性校准的多模态知识图谱RAG框架，用于实现紧凑且忠实的证据路由。给定一个问题及其相关的多模态输入，GraphLoom从基于场景的描述、提取的关系三元组和外部常识知识中构建实例级多模态知识图谱。GraphLoom并非将所有检索到的证据直接注入生成器，而是执行具有受限扩展的可靠性感知子图检索，并通过分层图记忆槽和联合图序列注意力机制，在冻结的语言模型中选择性路由高效用证据。为提升复杂推理场景下的鲁棒性，GraphLoom进一步增强了证据筛选与融合策略。
tldr: GraphLoom通过可靠性校准的图证据路由和受限子图扩展，在多模态知识图谱RAG中实现紧凑、忠实的证据选择，显著减少噪声并提升多跳推理能力。
en_tdlr: GraphLoom achieves compact and faithful evidence routing in multimodal KG-RAG via reliability-calibrated graph evidence routing and bounded subgraph expansion, effectively reducing noise and enhancing multi-hop reasoning.
